程序包 model

类 AuditLog

java.lang.Object
model.AuditLog
public class AuditLog extends Object
Represents a single audit log entry.

Each log records a user action with a timestamp, the user who performed it, their role, the action type, and additional details.

  • 构造器详细资料

    • AuditLog

      public AuditLog(String timestamp, String userId, String role, String action, String detail)
      Constructs a new audit log entry.
      参数:
      timestamp - when the action happened (format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss)
      userId - the ID of the user who performed the action
      role - the role of that user (TA, MO, Admin)
      action - a short code describing the action (e.g., LOGIN, TA_APPLY)
      detail - extra information about the action
